title: Great for a while the very dangerous!
text:
Great for a while the very dangerous!. This is my second Krups (same model) toaster oven. I had the same problems with the first and returned it for the same. Krups has a good name and I just figured it was a fluke. They both lasted very nicely for a couple of years then the buttons got finnicky and would work at all or had to be pushed multiple times to connect. More than once I had no number reading on the temp screen (just lines) and I had to unplug it to reset... No big deal but not what you expect to have to do with an expensive toaster oven.
However, my main concern is that the heating elements turn on and never adjusted. They crank up to high and stay there never acheiving the programmed temp. This has happened on more than one occasion. Fortunately, in times before, I had been In the room to catch it. It hadn't happened in a while and unfortunately the other night I forgot about the problem and left the room. I was gone max 2 minutes. When I returned the food inside was completely charred, and smoke was billowing out of the oven filling the house. Unacceptable! This all happened in a matter of minutes and has happened more than once.
Both ovens same model have proven to be very dangerous. No wonder it's been discontinued.
I have other Krups products that I love. I'm not knocking the company but this was very disturbing and has proven to be a real hazard.
